note: Real-world fidelity not tested. These numbers compare how fast and how consistently each backend runs SimSmith's own hand-written template scripts in this environment -- they say nothing about how closely any backend's physics matches a real robot.

backends.setup_notes: 100 of 100 on fresh seeds for both reach and pick_place, about 0.5-0.65s/run (WSL, CPU). Already installed in this worktree; no GPU and no license step. This is the backend every mode of this demo (--mock, --replay, live) actually runs.

Hand-written scripts, not LLM-generated; measured 2026-10-22/23. XPBD physics; needs collapse_fixed_joints=True or the solver diverges to NaN. About 9s of the ~12.5s/run is kinematic IK only. No pick_place support yet -- reach only.
